project.name: bot-pilot-connectors-calendar-spi
project.description:
Calendar SPI (Service Provider Interface) — the shared contract for ALL calendar connectors.
Contains: - Generic value objects: EventTime, EventAttendee, BusyEvent, BusyEventsResponse, CalendarEvent - Result type: CalendarEventCreationResult (sealed interface) - Driven port interfaces: CalendarEventReader, CalendarEventWriter, CredentialRepository - Exception types: NotAuthenticatedException
Why a dedicated SPI module instead of putting these in the Google connector's domain? Because Outlook Calendar, Apple Calendar, etc. should all speak the SAME language as far as the application layer and REST adapter are concerned. The SPI module is the shared vocabulary. Each concrete connector (Google, Outlook) provides implementations of the port interfaces defined here — the use cases never import anything Google-specific.
This module has zero framework dependencies: no Spring, no JPA. It is the innermost ring of the hexagon and must remain pure Java.
